description: Plan an IPv6 network: give each named network (LAN, Guest Wi-Fi, IoT, VLANs) its own /64 from a delegated prefix such as a /56 or /48. Returns each network's /64 prefix and a suggested router address (::1), plus how many /64s are left.

names.description: Network names, e.g. ["Home", "Guest Wi-Fi", "Cameras"] (up to 32; a comma-separated string also works)

name: ipv6_plan_networks
